searchText: is it possible to run L2 nodes as it is for main blockchain networks? or are L2 blocks generated by a centralized server? This varies from l2 network to l2 network. You can currently run nodes from a few of them, mostly in testnets. One way of centralization is to have a single sequencer dictating who can propose blocks. cool! tnx so, L2 is in general a network more centralized than L1, but that also uses blockchain to store the data? sidechains are independent and just have atomic swap with mainchain, while rollups eventually submit their transactions to mainchain, when those transactions become definitive? rollups are more centralized than L1, but are more transparent than off-chain centralized services because their transactions are public to be validated?
